# Space Law The charter of corporate rights grants the following rights to Nanotrasen Employees, in order of importance.
- 1. The right to follow corporate law. - 2. The right to work towards the greater wealth and prosperity of Nanotrasen. - 3. The right to respect one's superiors in management and understand the hard work they accomplished to achieve their position. - 4. The right to a Nanotrasen appointed public defender. If no lawyer is currently available, then a third party will be randomly selected for them. - 5. The right to not be prosecuted under a C§ 01 offense. This right is waived if the party fails to comply with lawful orders from security officers that resolves this offence.
## Treatment Of Prisoners
The charter of corporate rights grants the following rights to Nanotrasen Prisoners, in order of importance.
- 1. The right to medical treatment. - 2. The right to communications equipment, if not abused. - 3. The right to food and water. - 4. The right to their shift mandated PDA, unless tampered with; in which case a replacement will be issued. - 5. The right to freedom of movement within the designated brig. - 6. The right to request parole if a permanent prisoner; Conditions are set by the Warden or higher authority.
## Parole
The charter of corporate rights grants the following obligations to parolees, in order of importance. Corporate rights are waived if any of the following conditions are violated.
- 1. The obligation to remain sober. - 2. The obligation to pursue departmental employment. - 3. The obligation to inform department heads of criminal history. - 4. The obligation to report to the warden when requested. - 5. The obligation to allow any searches, regardless of alert level. - 6. The obligation to notify the warden of any departmental changes. - 7. The obligation to be monitored with the use of coordinate sensors or tracking implants.
## Security
The charter of corporate rights grants the following rights to Security Employees, in order of importance.
- 1. The right to search employees possessions on blue or higher alert, and to secure any contraband. - 2. The right to search employees suspected of a crime on any alert, and to secure any contraband. - 3. The right to check and remove any suspected illegal implants from crewmates suspected of possessing one. - 4. The right to implant any crewmate convicted of any crime with tracking and/or mindshield implants. - 5. The right to execute any crewmate refusing a mindshield implant. - 6. The right to waive brig time for corporal punishment, not exceeding critical condition.
## Sentencing
The charter of corporate rights grants the following rights to the Warden, Head of Security, and in their absence other security employees.
- 1. The right to sentence crewmates convicted of a crime for an appropriate time in the brig. - 2. The right to extend brig times for trouble caused. - 3. The right to use corporal punishment to retaliate against trouble caused. - 4. The right to the responsibility to preserve the life of all captured terrorists, magic users, and alien creatures for study at centcom.

# Execution - [bold]All executions are to be confirmed and overseen by the Captain.
# Narcotics and Prohibited substances
Schedule A: Any substance that is deemed minor or department-only contraband by the NT chemical compendium. Schedule B: Any substance that is deemed major contraband by the NT chemical compendium. Pyrotechnic: Any substance that is used for the purpose of arson, explosive or inciendiary attacks.
